UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: SaaS user account profile, active subscription plan, account status, and live study progress summary (without PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL from Google profile

status.description: Account access status controlled by Admin

currentDay.description: Current day number reached by the student (1-24)

currentLesson.description: Current lesson number reached by the student (1-8)

currentPage.description: Current textbook page reached by the student

speakingHistoryCount.description: Total completed live speaking practice sessions

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile or activity was last updated

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document containing the user's verified email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private info was last updated

CourseProgressDoc.title: CourseProgressDoc
CourseProgressDoc.description: Cloud-synced learning progress for a specific course book.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when progress record was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when progress record was updated

PlatformSettings.title: PlatformSettings
PlatformSettings.description: Global SaaS platform configuration managed exclusively by the Admin.

freeModeEnabled.description: When true, all lessons and features are unlocked for free for everyone

symbolicPriceMad.description: Symbolic subscription price in MAD for Goethe Pass

proPriceMad.description: Subscription price in MAD for Ausbildung Pro

announcementText.description: Announcement banner message controlled by Admin

allowNewSignups.description: Whether new users can sign up and access the platform immediately

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when platform settings were updated

/users/{userId}.description: Stores SaaS user account profile, plan tier, active/suspended status, and study progress summary.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) accessible exclusively by the owner or verified Admin.

/users/{userId}/progress/{bookId}.description: Stores cloud-synced textbook progress for each user.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores global platform pricing and free-launch mode settings.
